summary: Trivial __thiscall getter: reads and returns the dword at this + 0x400 (this[256]). No side effects. The owner class and the meaning of field 0x400 are unknown.

operations.description: Called by sub_587730 (0x00587730) and sub_5878A0 (0x005878A0) to read the getter's field.
Field address is this + 256 * sizeof(_DWORD), i.e. this + 0x400.
Return the dword read from field 0x400 of this; the call has no side effects.

unresolved: Field 0x400 of the owning object is unnamed; its meaning depends on the caller's object layout.
The owner class is unknown; only the field offset is evidenced.
